entities.name: the tariff offered by M/s. Solar Energy Corporation of India is found to be very competitive
tentative landed cost for the revised allocation of 200 MW remains same @ Rs.2.72 per unit

SECI's offer is very competitive and in order to meet out the RPO obligations, Board of TANGEDCO has accorded approval on 09.10.2023 for procurement of 500MW of solar power from M/s. SECI through ISTS Solar Tranche VIII scheme at the following rates: (i) 200 MW @ tentative cost of Rs.2.72 per kwhr (inclusive of trade margin of Rs.0.07 per kwhr) (ii) 300 MW @ tentative Rs.2.73 per kwhr

Commission has approved for procurement of 500MW of solar power from M/s.SECI at the rate of Rs.2.78l/unit (Applicable tariff of Rs.2.711/unit + SECI's trade margin of Rs.0.07/unit) under 1200 MW ISTS connected scheme, Tranche-VI by entering into a long term agreement to meet RPO target fixed to the State vide order dated 09.06.2020 in M.P.No.8 of 2020.

Commission has approved for procurement of 1000MW of solar power from M/s.SECI at the rate of Rs.2.61 per unit (Applicable tariff of Rs.2.54 per unit + SECI's trade margin of Rs.0.07 per unit) under Manufacturing linked ISTS scheme
